Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Ashley Aldrich, LE Master Esthetician Locations: Dover Ashley has been a licensed Aesthetician since 2018 and is passionate about all things skincare and corrective treatments. She specializes in helping clients feel confident in their skin and their bodies. As a certified body contouring specialist trained at CoolSculpting University and in Emsculpt NEO, Ashley focuses on sculpting transformative results. Her favorite treatments are body contouring and microneedling, because beauty is all about refinement. When Ashley is not in the treatment room, you’ll find her on the golf course or exploring the latest culinary gems around town.
